definitions.gloss: launching a publication; publishing (a new periodical or series)
definitions.explanation: The act of starting to publish a new magazine, journal, newspaper, or book series. Focuses on the initial launch rather than ongoing publication.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{雑誌|ざっし}を{発刊|はっかん}する。
その{学術|がくじゅつ}{誌|し}は1950{年|ねん}に{発刊|はっかん}された。
examples.english: That academic journal was first published in 1950.

examples.japanese: {地域|ちいき}の{情報|じょうほう}を{届|とど}けるフリーペーパーが{来月|らいげつ}{発刊|はっかん}される{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: A free paper delivering local information is scheduled to launch next month.

notes:
Composed of {発|はつ} (emit, launch) and {刊|かん} (publish, print). Specifically refers to the initial launch or founding of a publication such as a magazine, journal, or newspaper — not the ongoing act of publishing individual books. Can be used as a noun or with する as a verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雑誌|ざっし}を{発刊|はっかん}する: to launch a magazine
- {発刊|はっかん}から〜{年|ねん}: since the first issue ~ years ago
- {発刊|はっかん}{記念|きねん}: commemorating the launch
- {発刊|はっかん}の{辞|じ}: foreword to the inaugural issue

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出版|しゅっぱん}: publishing — the general act of publishing books; broader and more common
- {創刊|そうかん}: first issue, inaugural publication — very close to {発刊|はっかん} but more specifically refers to the very first number of a periodical
- {刊行|かんこう}: publication — formal; can refer to publishing books or periodicals on an ongoing basis

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
- {発汗|はっかん}: sweating — same reading but completely different meaning
